title: I can't wait to go back!!
text: There are so many food tours in Barcelona to choose from, but when I found this particular tour and read the reviews I immediately booked it. The guide was very informative about the history of Barcelona, the food, and wine. She truly cared if we were enjoying ourselves. The restaurants we went to were top-notch. The max number of people on this tour is 14 which makes it perfect.  We met so many great travelers from all over the world on this tour and enjoyed their company.  I would do this tour over and over again! Book it!
author: connie_f

title: Great introduction to Spanish tapas and wine!
text: This tour was the perfect introduction to Spanish food and culture!  Paulina shared the history of Spain, along with a detailed description of the food and wine, which was delicious at each spot.  Great choices, great guide, highly recommend!
